 Chow Yun Fat, 71, Criticised For Jogging On Road Instead Of Pedestrian Path
 The fitness-loving actor's latest run has sparked concern online, though some fans defended him, saying there may not have been a suitable alternative route.
 Bryan Wong

 At 71, Chow Yun Fat is probably fitter than many people half his age.
 The Hong Kong superstar, affectionately known as Fat Gor, is more known these days for his love of jogging and hiking, and is often spotted exercising around Hong Kong.
 But his latest run has got netizens a little worried.
 According to Hong Kong media reports, a netizen recently spotted Fat Gor jogging alone near the Central and Western District Promenade on Hong Kong Island.
 The actor appeared relaxed as he went about his workout, with no one approaching or disturbing him.
 Sounds like a pretty normal day for the famously down-to-earth star, right?
 Well, not quite. Eagle-eyed netizens noticed that Fat Gor appeared to be jogging on the road rather than on a pedestrian pavement or designated running path.
 And some weren't too pleased with his choice of route.
 "Running in the middle of the road? That's not a good idea, right?" read a comment.
 "This isn't a suitable place for jogging," another wrote.
 After all, no matter how fit you are, running alongside moving vehicles isn't exactly ideal.
 However, not everyone thought Fat Gor was doing anything unusual.
 "That's just how things are in Hong Kong. There's no other choice!" a fan defended him.
 Of course, it's unclear whether the stretch of road was open to traffic at the time or whether there was a designated running path nearby.
 Still, we can understand why fans were concerned.
 After all, he has spent years showing that staying active doesn't have to stop as you get older.
 Fat Gor, keep running. Just watch out for the cars, okay?
